hypotheses.title: Registered hypotheses (ca_rebound run e1-ca_rebound-s0-plus-litellm-r3)
hypotheses.content:
H1 (LIVE): Slow persistent voltage-gated Na-like depolarizing current (NaP). Activates V>-50mV, tau>200ms, non-inactivating, sustained inward drive. Predicts: strong step [17,24], depol cond+test [36,45], hyperpol cond+test [12,18].

H2 (LIVE): Ca-activated non-specific cation current (I_CAN). Ca2+-dependent activation (not directly voltage-gated), slow kinetics from Ca diffusion/buffering. Predicts: strong step [15,22], depol cond+test [35,46], hyperpol pre-pulse+weak test [10,15] (same as weak step alone since hyperpol doesn't load Ca), paired long pulses 2nd pulse [28,40] (residual Ca boost).

H3 (LIVE but weakened): Noise artifact — no extra current, all differences within stochastic variation of reference model. Predicts: all spike counts within ±2 of reference (already contradicted: strong step real=19 vs ref max=16).

observed-data.title: Observed real-cell vs reference model spike counts (6 protocols)
observed-data.content:
Protocol | Real | Ref (no extra, slow_na=false) | Ref range
hyperpol cond+test (-30uA/250ms then +12uA) | 16 | 15.6 | 13-18
depol cond+test (+15uA/250ms then +12uA) | 40 | 36.0 | 32-41
brief step (12uA, 40ms) | 7 | 6.0 | 4-8
long step (10uA, 300ms) | 32 | (not yet simulated)
strong step (18uA, 120ms) | 19 | 13.7 | 10-16 ← real exceeds ref max
weak step (5uA, 120ms) | 14 | 11.3 | 10-13

Key pattern: real cell consistently fires more spikes than reference, especially under strong/sustained depolarization. Depol conditioning boosts test response (40 vs 36) suggesting a mechanism that accumulates during depolarization.

remaining-plan.title: Remaining budget, probe targets, and methodological constraints
remaining-plan.content:
Budget: 3 of 8 observations remaining.

Probe targets (discriminate H1 vs H2):
1. hyperpol pre-pulse + weak test (-30uA/250ms, gap, +6uA): H1 predicts rebound boost (de-inactivation); H2 predicts same as weak step alone (no Ca loaded during hyperpol).
2. paired long pulses (12uA/300ms, 60ms gap, 12uA/300ms): H2 predicts 2nd pulse boosted by residual Ca [28,40]; H1 predicts same as 1st pulse (no Ca mechanism).

Methodological constraint: Pre-register probes with bands derived from theoretical reasoning ONLY. Never peek at simulation candidates to derive bands — doing so turns prediction into回忆 (recall) and invalidates the evidence chain. Write prereg first, then run.

After probes: grill (attack) LIVE hypotheses, then forecast 6 held-out test protocols (hyperpol -25/-30/-35/-40 release, brief step 12uA/40ms, long step 10uA/300ms).
